# Successor public Greedy input recipes

The frozen source-only manifest contains 422 requests and 73,016,258 source bytes.
It preserves all 159 broader DoubleFast and 92 original Fast-derived source/request
pairs, adds all 138 ordinary Greedy sources as public whole-buffer calls, the
original `unsupported-57` selector prefix, and 32 new boundary/control requests.
The prior manifests, observations and source generators remain immutable.

Before codec execution, v3 admission predicts 372 successes, 37 unsupported
strategies and 13 resource failures. Public known-size adjustment matters:
`greedy-row_search29` and `greedy-row_unused_chain29` have small source sizes and
resolve to chain storage with search log 29, so these public requests reject.
Their earlier explicit internal row observations remain valid separate evidence.
An ordinary source name does not assert its original schedule or selected family
survives a public call.

Twenty-five Rust frame-equivalence groups preserve the 16 older hypotheses and
add chain/row key-width clamps, ignored targets, source hints, row visit caps and
unused row chain dimensions. Maximum row hash/window and resource boundaries
are included. No expected compressed bytes or C applied scalars are generated.
Preserve failed hypotheses in the eventual capture.

    python3 scripts/check_greedy_interop_recipes.py --check

This checker regenerates sources and checks immutable identities without running
codecs, compilers or archived programs. New C execution uses the separately
reviewed successor protocol; it does not overwrite historical not-run records.
